Hi Liam — thanks for the clear asks. Quick summary below and I've attached a short options doc and a mutual action plan you can share with procurement.

1) Upgrades mid-period (Compact -> Throughput):
- We support immediate upgrades. Usage during the billing period is billed at the higher tier pro-rated by days.
- Any previously-purchased credits remain; we apply new per-token rates going forward.
- If you want predictable unit pricing during an upgrade, we can issue a one-time adjustment credit to smooth the delta (typically used in enterprise pilots).

2) Downgrades (Throughput -> Compact):
- Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle. This avoids mid-cycle behavior change and KV cache regressions.
- We offer a 30-day grace for critical regressions where you can pause the downgrade and revert to Throughput for a short window.

3) Private deployment + retention add-on:
- Private deployment (VPC) is an add-on that can be purchased on top of Compact for small scale pilots.
- Longer retention (audit logs, traces) is tied to the Visibility & Ops bundle; for full retention guarantees we typically require at least the Core tier due to storage and retention SLAs. However, we can scope a limited retention add-on for Compact pilots (30-day window) as a stopgap.

Attached: SlatePlan_Options_v1.pdf (summary table) and MutualActionPlan_SlatePlan.xlsx (timelines + approvals).

Next steps:

Cheers,

Liam — quick pricing note to complement Priyom's playbook:

Pricing options we recommend for Medica's rollout:
- Pilot (Compact + Private pilot add-on): standard Compact rate, add-on charged monthly. No volume discount.
- Stage (Committed Throughput): 3-6 month commit with a stepped discount ladder (5–12% depending on commit size).
- Production (Annual Dedicated): custom pricing, typically includes a signing credit tied to forecast and a 10–20% uplift credit against first-quarter overage.

Adjustment credits: for mid-quarter upgrades we typically offer a smoothing credit equal to the delta in expected spend vs. a simple pro-rata charge, capped at the lesser of 10% of monthly invoice or $25k for pilots. If procurement needs a firmer ceiling, we can structure a capped overage line item.

Contracts/legal: Legal will need to confirm change-of-service language (downgrade window, retention commitments). If you share your procurement checklist we'll map items in the attached MAP.

Happy to run numbers if you can share expected token volumes for pilot vs. production.
